summary: The Park District decided to contact the School District and City of Chicago Heights to verify the replacement scheme before reconsidering the matter of 'non-significance,' promising a response within thirty days, after which the document would be updated prior to FHWA submission.
text:
It was decided, at the meeting, that the Park District would contact the School District and the City of Chicago Heights to verify the replacement scheme; and then would again consider the matter of "non-significance". Because of the time required for review and upon consideration of their regular scheduled meetings, the Park District Board promised to have a response within thirty (30) days.
Upon receipt of response from the Park District, it will replace this page; and appropriate documentation and text material will be revised appropriately, prior to submission to FHWA for signature of adoption.
